package orgs

import (
	"context"

	"example.test/tenantjobs/internal/scope"
)

// Sweep records one sweep row for the verified tenant. The tenant and the
// acting service subject come from the execution, never from input.
func Sweep(
	ctx context.Context,
	e scope.Execution,
	ports SweepPorts,
) error {
	return ports.Sweeps.Record(ctx, e)
}
